skills.name: analogue-circuit-dsp
skills.description: Develop and review behavioural analogue-circuit models for audio DSP, especially JSFX/EEL2 workbench experiments. Use when translating schematics, measurements, or circuit behaviour into reusable DSP blocks; deciding model boundaries; separating ideal controls from finite analogue stages; modelling rails, feedback, bandwidth, slew, noise, summing, filters, or nonlinearities; and designing validation/null tests. Prefer topology-informed, measurable abstractions over component cosplay, and keep project-specific evidence distinct from general modelling assumptions.

skills.name: dsp-discovery-promotion
skills.description: Promote a DSP idea from JSFX, Reaktor Core, legacy personal plugins, experiments, papers, or measurements into a small portable StoneyDSP primitive. Use when auditing candidate source, recovering a proven behaviour, defining its contract, or deciding whether it belongs in the library.

skills.name: juce-cmake-consumer-integration
skills.description: Integrate StoneyDSP into a JUCE CMake product without turning the library into a JUCE dependency or duplicating its implementation. Use when creating or reviewing a JUCE plugin, standalone app, consumer smoke test, or optional JUCE-module adapter.

skills.name: portable-api-evolution
skills.description: Change or review StoneyDSP C/C++ public declarations, visibility macros, ABI-sensitive types, or realtime processor ownership across GCC, Clang, MinGW, and MSVC. Use when compiler/linker failures involve exports, C linkage, variadic macros, templates, or installed consumer behaviour.

skills.name: public-api-consumer-validation
skills.description: Validate a portable C/C++ library as an external consumer across package targets, static/shared linkage, and representative toolchains. Use when adding or reviewing consumer smoke tests, install/export checks, ABI visibility coverage, or C compatibility validation in StoneyDSP.

skills.name: web-ui-native-bridge
skills.description: Design and validate a bounded web-like UI to JUCE-native audio bridge while preserving host automation, realtime safety, and editor-independent audio. Use when a StoneyDSP product uses JUCE WebBrowserComponent, TypeScript, Canvas/WebGL, Lightning, DOM, or a future StoneyUI contract.
